wallet_is_claimed.meaning: AtomWallet isClaimed flag at the pre-validation checkpoint

multivault_staked_in_entrypoint.meaning: whether MultiVault is staked in the EntryPoint (false: plain protocol contract)

claim_requires_direct_onchain_tx.meaning: claiming the wallet requires a direct on-chain transaction (the reported impact), rather than being achievable through bundler-based UserOp flow
claim_requires_direct_onchain_tx.checkpoint: at the claim step for the unclaimed AtomWallet

assumptions: A UserOp for the unclaimed AtomWallet is submitted to a compliant bundler for simulation (userop_submitted).
validateUserOp is invoked and reaches _validateSignature/owner() during simulation (validate_userop_called).

unresolved.description: Report does not give a numeric or structural definition of the direct-onchain-claim requirement; the impact is represented as a grounded Boolean outcome only.

limitations: The selected impact is an availability consequence; the direct storage-read mechanism (owner() reading MultiVault via getAtomWarden()) is not itself the formalized effect.
Caller authorization for validateUserOp is unspecified; the condition uses only the report-stated unclaimed and unstaked facts.
Post-claim behavior (isClaimed = true reading local storage) is out of scope for this impact's claim.
